title: RAG pipeline 5-seed ablation sweep
what: accuracy cost (points) of dropping the reranker or the bigger encoder

reader_questions.question: How many points of accuracy does the model lose when the reranker is removed?
How is run-to-run variability represented?
reader_questions.expected: Across 5 seeds (individual seed points and/or mean ± SD/CI).

reader_questions.question: Which component causes the largest drop when removed?
reader_questions.expected: Dropping retrieval causes the largest drop, whereas the bigger encoder adds only ~0.5 points.
